name: net_minority_desync_resyncs
description: Three clients. At tick 2,000 a bug writes client 3's own gold to 999: its next hash parts from the other two, a minority. The sequencer sends it RESYNC(desync) from the latest agreed checkpoint, with the parts and the turns since; client 3 checks the parts' digest, loads them, drops what it ran past them, runs the turns again (catching up, its orders waiting) and is level again with its gold as the others hold it. Every hash any client sends after that agrees, the match plays on for all three, and the resync was its first (a second would end it alone).

steps.msg: tick 2,000, and every hash agreed so far

steps.assert: resynced and resync[1] == 2 and resync[2] == 'desync' and resync[3] > 0 and resync[3] < 2060
steps.msg: the minority, wire seat 2, got RESYNC(desync) from a checkpoint before the bad tick
its first hash after the bug, tick 2,040, was the one that parted

steps.assert: caught_up and scene.client(3).resyncs[0][0] == 'desync' and scene.client(3).resyncs[0][1] == resync[3]
steps.msg: client 3 loaded that checkpoint and caught up
its overlay said catching up while it did
its gold is the others' view of it again
every hash after the resync agreed; the match plays on for all three
the three clients' hash streams agree from the checkpoint on, client 3 level with the others
